resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says abandoned; the Oregon lookout list says gone. The record uses gone from the list and keeps the abandoned description in the note.
A 1938 survey description calls the East Butte tower China Hat Lookout, but the China Hat record is a separate site on Firelookout.com. The sources do not settle whether the two are one tower.

notes_for_editor: Key open question: the 1936 letter, quoted on Forest Lookouts' East Butte page, calls the East Butte tower China Hat Lookout. The East Butte record (us-or-east-butte, 43.66688, -120.99593, standing) lies about 3.4 km from the China Hat coordinates (43.68057, -121.03386), and the NHLR page says that tower was replaced in 1995. If the China Hat record is the same tower, merge it into East Butte or retire it. Firelookout.com's separate China Hat site (22 miles east of LaPine, 6,573 ft) may still be a different structure; no source gives its built date, design or height. Staffing, access and visit are omitted because no source covers them. No new photos. The FFLA list gives the kind as Unknown.
